**Finding submitted — deviation (Section 19, ¶p0133).**

Section 19 is the only responsive clause in the document. As drafted it is a mutual **no-hire** ("agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire") covering **any employee of the other party**, for one year after termination, with **no** general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. That combination (no-hire + all personnel) is walk-away territory and fails our fallback on material terms.

Redline (validated, minimality gate passed): a single surgical replacement of the operative sentence converting it to a mutual **non-solicitation** limited to personnel directly involved in the services, running **12 months after that involvement ends**, expressly not prohibiting hiring, and carving out general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. All six fallback elements are carried by that one operation.
